name: proto-protojson-unmarshal-caps
description: Hand code decoding a message from ProtoJSON without discarding unknown fields gives every consumer of that message the persistence cap, whatever its state: the message, the field read after decoding and the field only the decoding writes. A message decoded with unknown fields discarded carries no cap.
pending: bindings.16: deadset-go and deadset-ts publish cap persistence on the consumers of a message decoded from ProtoJSON keeping unknown fields (GO5, J7).
